notes: COVERAGE: Maui County (islands of Maui, Molokai, Lanai; Kalawao parcels in TMK zone 6 included) is complete. Hawaii County and Kauai County owner MAILING addresses could not be obtained from any free public source reachable from this environment (see counties.*.attempts). For those two counties only an owner-occupancy/tax-class PROXY is given; it is NOT a mailing-address measure and must not be presented as an out-of-state share.

MAUI DATA DATE: mailing addresses from the live production parcel fabric (Parcel_Fabric_Layers/1, dataLastEditDate 2026-10-04); tax class, situs city and CPR flag from PARCELINFO (CAMA join 'updated weekly', item modified 2026-10-07); owner type and homeowner flag from the 2026 certified roll (Maui_County_Certified_Parcels_2026 tables, data edited 2026-04-10, TAXYR 2026). The mauicounty.gov 'Property Owners & Mailing Addresses' download page itself was blocked (Cloudflare 403).

MAUI UNIT OF COUNT: one record per 13-digit TMK (county digit 2 + zone + section + plat(3) + parcel(3) + CPR(4)), so each condominium/CPR unit counts as one parcel. 1,187 records whose OWNERNME1 contains 'CONDO MASTER' (common-element/master records) are excluded, mirroring the Oahu treatment of condo masters.

MAUI MAILING ADDRESS: the fabric carries ONE postal address per parcel (PSTLADDRESS/PSTLCITY/PSTLSTATE/PSTLZIP5/PSTLCOUNTRY), i.e. the tax-bill mailing address. PSTLCOUNTRY 'US' + PSTLSTATE gives the US state; non-US countries are normalized with the same alias list as the Oahu file plus overrides (NORTHERN IRELAND/UK -> United Kingdom; BRITISH COLUMBIA -> Canada; AUSTRAILIA -> Australia; CHANNEL ISLANDS kept separate; one 'VICTORIA' left unresolved). 'Other US state' = 49 states + DC; US territories (PR, GU, MP, AS, VI) and APO/FPO (AA/AE/AP) are separate buckets counted in non_hawaii_total.

MAUI FALLBACK: 4,595 fabric records have a blank postal address. For those, the first owner mailing record with a classifiable address in the certified 2026 roll (RPFMAIL, OBJECTID order) is used ('fallback_certified_rpfmail'). 'all_parcels_strict_fabric_only' gives the no-fallback result. RPFMAIL has one row per owner name (141,149 rows); only some rows carry an address and 265 carry only a '00000' ZIP placeholder (treated as no address).

MAUI CROSS-CHECK: live fabric category vs certified-roll category agree on the share reported in crosscheck_live_fabric_vs_certified_rpfmail (differences are mostly ownership/mailing changes between April and October 2026 and multi-owner parcels whose first addressed owner differs from the tax-bill address). 'sensitivity_any_owner_record_non_hawaii_certified_roll' counts a parcel as non-Hawaii if ANY owner mailing record in the certified roll is outside Hawaii (upper-bound style measure).

MAUI TAX CLASS LABELS ARE INFERRED (no code-to-label lookup is published in the layers): code 9 = Owner-Occupied (all 28,974 certified-roll 900-coded parcels carry Homeowner='Y' and live exemptions are home exemptions); 12 = Long-Term Rental (2,807 of 3,141 carry 'LONG TERM RENTAL EXEMPTION'); 11 = Short-Term Rental (6,108 of 7,060 CPR units in the County's 101 'Minatoya list' complexes are code 11); 1 = Non-Owner-Occupied residential; 5 Agricultural; 6 Conservation; 3 Commercial; 4 Industrial; 2 Apartment; 7 Hotel & Resort; 10 Commercialized Residential; code 0 is 1,938 timeshare-plan-manager parcels + others (probably Time Share); 999 unlabeled. Verify against Maui RPT before publishing. Live PARCELINFO codes (1-12) equal certified RPFVALUE codes/100.

MAUI CONDO: 'by_condo_unit' uses membership in the County's 'Tax Parcel - Condos' fabric layer (30,370 units; identical to CPR suffix != 0000 in practice). PARCELINFO's CPR flag (YES/NO) is TMK-level and also flags CPR'd house/ag lots.

MAUI GEOGRAPHY: situs region uses PARCELINFO CITYNAME (postal city of the property; 'KIHEI' includes Wailea/Makena and 'LAHAINA' includes Kaanapali/Napili/Kapalua). TMK zone labels are the traditional Maui County tax-map districts (approximate); each zone lists its top situs cities so the label can be checked. Hawaii mailing ZIPs are split into Maui County / Oahu / Hawaii Island / Kauai by USPS ZIP lists.

MAUI METROS: same hand-built approximate ZIP3 -> metro mapping as the Oahu file (not an official ZIP-to-CBSA crosswalk), plus one addition: ZIP3 338 -> 'Lakeland-Winter Haven FL' (ZIP 33801 is a single institutional mailing address for hundreds of Maui parcels).

MAUI INSTITUTIONAL OWNERS: timeshare plan managers, developers, trusts and agents receive many tax bills at one address (see mailing_address_concentration and parcels_at_addresses_with_10plus_parcels by ZIP). '..._excluding_addresses_with_10plus_parcels' removes parcels at any identical normalized mailing address shared by >= 10 parcels.

INTERPRETATION: a mailing address is where the tax bill goes, not proof of residence. Out-of-state addresses can be trustees or agents for local owners; absentee owners using a Hawaii property manager or attorney appear as Hawaii. Treat non-Hawaii shares as a floor on non-resident ownership.

OFFICIAL MAUI AGGREGATES: Maui County GIS published 'Ownership by Mailing Address' layers for 2022 and 2023 (counts by HI ZIP, US state, country). They count ~87k mailing records (not parcels) with an undocumented method; included only as context.

KAUAI PROXY: TY26_PropertyTaxData (tax year 2026; layer data edited 2026-02-11; 37,655 mapped parcel/CPR records - some CPR units are unmapped per the County's layer description). Kauai's tax classes are labeled in the data (e.g. '8:OWNER-OCCUPIED', '1:NON-OWNER-OCCUPIED RESIDENTIAL', '2:VACATION RENTAL'). The owner-occupied share of residential records is a residency PROXY (home-exemption based), not a mailing-address result.

HAWAII COUNTY PROXY: cohRPT2026 (135,718 parcel polygons incl. 76 repeated TMKs from multipart parcels; 9-digit TMK without CPR suffix, so condo units are not separately represented; data edited 2026-04-28). Homeowner='Y' marks parcels with a home exemption (owner-occupancy proxy). Because Puna and Kau contain tens of thousands of vacant subdivision lots, 'homeowner_Y_share_of_improved' (parcels with BldgValue > 0) is the more meaningful figure; all Y parcels are improved. PittCode values (0,100,...,700,999) have no published labels in the layer and are reported as codes only.

PRIVACY: owner names and street addresses are not included in this file; raw pages containing them are kept only in the raw folder. Kauai and Hawaii County pulls deliberately excluded owner-name fields.
